label: Small Biotech IND — Nonclinical Overview (2.4)
description: Module 2.4 Nonclinical Overview for NovaTide-1 bispecific antibody (pharmacology, PK, toxicology).

inputs.nonclinical_strategy: NovaTide-1 is a CD3×CD20 bispecific antibody that requires cross-reactivity with the target species for meaningful pharmacology and toxicology. Cynomolgus monkey was identified as the only relevant species based on CD20 and CD3 epitope conservation. Standard ICH S6(R1) and S9 principles were applied.
inputs.primary_pd: NovaTide-1 redirected T-cell–mediated killing of CD20+ B cells in vitro (EC50 = 0.8 pM) and in vivo in NOD/SCID xenograft models with co-engrafted human PBMCs. Complete tumor regression observed in 8/10 mice at 0.5 mg/kg biweekly.
inputs.secondary_pd: No off-target binding observed in tissue cross-reactivity study (normal human tissue panel, 38 tissues). Confirmed monospecificity for CD3 and CD20.
inputs.cv_finding: No QTc prolongation; transient hypotension at Cmax consistent with cytokine release
inputs.resp_finding: No respiratory depression; transient tachypnea at 10 mg/kg (Cmax-related)
inputs.pd_interactions: Not studied — no concomitant medications anticipated in Phase 1 design
inputs.sd_finding_1: Transient cytokine release (IL-6, TNFα) at ≥10 mg/kg; B-cell depletion; full recovery by Day 28
inputs.rd_finding_1: Expected B-cell depletion; transient CRS at first dose; lymphoid tissue changes (reversible). NOAEL = 3 mg/kg.
inputs.rd_finding_2: Consistent with 4-week study. Full B-cell recovery by Week 8 post-dose. No cumulative toxicity.
inputs.genotoxicity_summary: Not required per ICH S6(R1) for monoclonal antibodies. Ames and in vitro micronucleus performed for completeness — both negative.
inputs.carcinogenicity_summary: Not required per ICH S6(R1) and S9 for oncology indication. No concern based on mechanism (T-cell redirection, not genotoxic).
inputs.repro_tox_summary: Embryo-fetal development study in cynomolgus monkeys: no teratogenicity at doses up to 10 mg/kg. B-cell depletion observed in neonates (expected pharmacology). Fertility studies not required per ICH S6(R1).
inputs.nonclinical_conclusions: The nonclinical profile of NovaTide-1 supports initiation of Phase 1 clinical trials. The pharmacology, PK, and toxicology are consistent with the CD3×CD20 bispecific antibody class. The main safety finding (cytokine release) is on-target and manageable with clinical mitigation strategies.
inputs.hed_calculation: NOAEL in monkey = 3 mg/kg → HED = 1 mg/kg (using body surface area conversion factor of 3.1). Safety margin at proposed starting dose (0.1 mg/kg) = 10×.
inputs.starting_dose_rationale: Proposed Phase 1 starting dose: 0.1 mg/kg IV, providing a 10-fold safety margin from the NOAEL-derived HED and consistent with MABEL-based calculations. MABEL approach: EC20 in vitro cytokine release = 0.05 µg/mL; at 0.1 mg/kg, predicted Cmax = 2 µg/mL (within 10× of MABEL). Starting dose supported by both approaches.
